EmailTemplate.name: Transfer Case to University Registrar Services (Student)
EmailTemplate.subject: Appealing your admission decision
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
I'm sorry to hear that you were denied admission to ASU. You can appeal your admission decision if you feel ASU will provide you with the best opportunity to be academically successful.
To appeal your admission decision, please submit:
- a letter explaining your academic record and your plan to be successful at ASU - three supporting letters of recommendation from faculty - additional materials, such as improved ACT or SAT test scores, that may meet admission requirements* (https://students.asu.edu/freshman/requirements)
*New test scores must be sent directly from the testing agency. Please indicate in your appeal letter that you are submitting new scores for the committee to review.
Send your appeal letter and recommendations electronically to AdmissionAppeals@asu.edu.
There is no set time frame on an appeal decision as students are reviewed on a case-by-case basis. The admission appeal board meets regularly to review completed files for appeal.
For many people, community college is a great pathway to ASU. Many students demonstrate academic success by starting at the community college level and then transferring to ASU (https://transfer.asu.edu/).
Please let me know if you have any additional questions about the admission process.
{!User.Recruiter_Full_Name__c} {!User.Recruiter_Title__c} Admission Services {!User.Recruiter_Email__c} {!User.Recruiter_Phone__c}
If you would like any additional information or have questions related to this subject, please reply to this email.
